ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

2. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

3. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.

4. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

5. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library?

6. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

8. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.

9. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

10. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. One main idea with supporting sentences
   D. Only one word repeated

12. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.

13. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.

14. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
